biographyParagraphs: Jeff Duartê is a Brazilian-born makeup artist and creative director whose merges theatrical sensibility with contemporary fashion and beauty. Born in Governador Valadares
Minas Gerais
Brazil
Jeff’s artistic foundation began in theater
where he trained formally in 2001 and spent over a decade working as an actor and cultural producer with collaborating Brazilian cultural institutions
including Centro Cultural Usiminas
Governo do Estado de Minas Gerais
Caixa Cultural
and many theatrical companies.
He holds a degree in Advertising and Communications and later pursued advanced studies in MBA Digital Marketing and Research Languages
publishing academic research focused on communication and visual expression. This multidisciplinary background informs his refined eye for composition
narrative
and identity-driven beauty.
In fact
Jeff began his professional career in makeup in 2016 under the mentorship of renowned Brazilian artist Jô Martins in Belo Horizonte
Minas Gerais
where he developed technical precision and backstage expertise.
His editorial collaborations include Brazilian fashion photographers Weber de Padua and Marcio Rodrigues
and he has contributed to major fashion backstages
fashion brands
High-End Labels
Apparel Stores' lookbooks
and Designer Labels.
After relocating to the United States in 2019
his practice expanded through direct access to global beauty houses. Joining Sephora in 2023 further sharpened his product fluency
allowing continuous experimentation with emerging formulas and industry innovation.
Today
Jeff Duartê approaches beauty as structure and expression — balancing disciplined technique with an instinct for modern elegance.
